title: 义务教育教科书·英语（清华版）三年级下册

units.title: Unit 2
units.themeEn: Where do you want to go?

sentences.cn: 你准备好迎接新学期了吗？
sentences.en: Are you ready for the new semester?
I’m ready for school.

sentences.cn: 这学期我们有一门新科目。
sentences.en: We have a new subject this semester.
Welcome back to school, everyone.
I get up early and have breakfast at seven.

sentences.cn: 今天上午我有数学课和英语课。
sentences.en: This morning I have math and English.

sentences.cn: 我们在学校学语文、数学和英语。
sentences.en: We learn Chinese, math and English at school.

sentences.cn: 现在我们在操场上体育课。
sentences.en: Now we have PE in the playground.
I am excited about my new textbook.

sentences.cn: 这些是我的铅笔和橡皮。
sentences.en: These are my pencil and my eraser.

sentences.cn: 我的书包里装满了东西。
sentences.en: My schoolbag is full of things.

sentences.cn: 我会把我的新尺子给你看。
sentences.en: I will show you my new ruler.

sentences.cn: 天空是蓝的，教室里很安静。
sentences.en: The sky is blue and the class is quiet.

sentences.cn: 你的新床是什么颜色的？
sentences.en: What color is your new bed?

sentences.cn: 我在英语课上感觉很开心。
sentences.en: I feel happy in my English class.

sentences.cn: 所有同学都回来了，教室亮堂堂的。
sentences.en: All the students are back and the classroom is bright.
I want to visit the Science Museum.
I want to row a boat.
Let’s have a picnic in the park.
Spring break is a good time to travel.
Let’s fly a kite in the park.
I want to see the pandas in the zoo.

sentences.cn: 这个孩子正在电视上看比赛。
sentences.en: The child is watching a game on TV.

sentences.cn: 春天很多人来到这座城市。
sentences.en: Many people come to the city in spring.

sentences.cn: 公园里有很多高大的树。
sentences.en: There are many tall trees in the park.
Let’s take photos of the panda.
The monkey can catch the ball with its head.

sentences.cn: 红苹果从高高的树上落下来。
sentences.en: Red apples fall from the tall tree.
My school is far from the city.

sentences.cn: 我们为自己最喜欢的游戏投票。
sentences.en: We vote for our favourite game.

sentences.cn: 我们聊聊动物园里的动物吧。
sentences.en: Let’s talk about the animals in the zoo.
Stand there and watch me.
Do you like meat?
This is a good place to have a picnic.
Let me take a photo of the tiger.

sentences.cn: 外面天亮的时候要关灯。
sentences.en: Turn off the light when it is light outside.
Can I turn on the light, Mom?
Use old things to make new things.
It is dark and cold outside.

sentences.cn: 我的哥哥和姐姐都在我这个大家庭里。
sentences.en: My brother and sister are in my big family.
I need a bottle of water.

sentences.cn: 我从小妹妹那里收到一张贺卡。
sentences.en: I get a card from my little sister.
My mother is a good cook.
Please drink some warm water.
There is a small river near my home.

sentences.cn: 植物需要阳光和水才能生长。
sentences.en: The plant needs light and water to grow.
Where is my other shoe?
I live with my grandmother.

sentences.cn: 我有三本故事书和四张卡片。
sentences.en: I have three storybooks and four cards.
It is time to sleep now.
Her homework is clean.

sentences.cn: 我们坐出租车去博物馆。
sentences.en: We take a taxi to the museum.
A bottle is a holder for water.
The little boy is not bad at math.
It is cold, but I like winter.
My shoes are small but clean.
I throw trash into the trash can.
I want to go to the zoo.
Please stand in line.
I get up at six o’clock and go to bed at nine.

sentences.cn: 每个人都应该保持教室整洁。
sentences.en: Everybody should keep the classroom tidy.

sentences.cn: 请马上把地上的垃圾捡起来。
sentences.en: Please pick up the trash on the ground right away.

sentences.cn: 我的书桌很乱，书也很脏。
sentences.en: My desk is messy and my books are dirty.
We cross the street after school.
There are twenty students in a line.
I wait for the bus near my home.
Wake up, it is time to get up.

sentences.cn: 这只猫很可爱，它在海滩上。
sentences.en: The cat is cute and it is on the beach.

sentences.cn: 每天晚上我读一小时书。
sentences.en: Every night I read for an hour.
Turn left and stop at the corner.
Look up at the sky.

sentences.cn: 比赛结束了，我们该回家了。
sentences.en: The game is over, and we should go home.
